summary.intent: Run a code quality review (reuse, quality, efficiency) on all Phase 24 changes and fix any issues found.
summary.outcome: Four issues were fixed: publishWithVerify now publishes once and retries only verification; useAuth.ts uses existing computeIpHash() instead of inlining SHA-256; load test upload workload adds data.fill(0); duplicated validation in schema.ts was deduplicated. All 171 core tests and 69 SDK unit tests pass.

repo: computeIpHash() utility exists in apps/web/src/lib/device/info.ts and should be used instead of inlining SHA-256 logic
publishWithVerify in packages/sdk/src/bin/index.ts was previously re-publishing on every retry; correct pattern is publish-once then retry verification only
Web app has pre-existing TypeScript errors unrelated to Phase 24 changes (different import names from a prior refactor)
Load tests have pre-existing type errors in byo-file-workload.ts, not in sdk-core-workload.ts
2 SDK integration tests fail when API is not running — this is a pre-existing baseline, not a regression

code.finding: publishWithVerify was re-publishing on every retry loop iteration; fixed to publish once outside the loop and retry only the verification step
Inlined SHA-256 ipHash computation replaced with existing computeIpHash() already imported from device/info.ts
Upload workload missing data.fill(0) to initialize buffer; also had a broken try/catch/finally structure introduced during editing that required a second fix pass
Duplicated sequenceNumber/devices validation logic was consolidated
Retry test asserted createAndPublishIpnsRecord called twice; updated to expect once after publish-once refactor

workflow: Editing a try/catch/finally block in small increments can corrupt structure; always re-read the full function after editing control flow
Running type-check after edits catches import/type issues early, even when pre-existing errors exist in the same project
Agent-based parallel review (reuse/quality/efficiency) is effective for batching code review; aggregating findings before fixing avoids redundant reads

friction: Editing sdk-core-workload.ts broke the try/catch/finally structure mid-edit, requiring a read and second fix pass
Large diff required multiple paginated reads of the same tool-result file before the full content was available
Pre-existing TypeScript errors in the web app and load tests added noise when verifying that new changes compile cleanly
open_items: Pre-existing TypeScript errors in apps/web (import name mismatch from prior refactor) remain unfixed
Pre-existing type errors in tests/load/src/workloads/byo-file-workload.ts not addressed
2 SDK integration tests require a running API to pass — no test harness automation for this yet
